title: Lilac Causeway
description: Broad three-two phrases cross a narrower five-beat causeway. In that middle span a tenor line begins beneath the soloist, drawing the harmony towards the lower register. The broad metre returns with a fuller ensemble and settles into a high, unresolved ninth.
technical_note: Treat the metre change as a change of stride, without hurrying the shorter bars. Sustain the left-hand bass while articulating its independent tenor. Keep the long right-hand line audible through the chordal return and clear each pedal release.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
